extraction.boundary: Valid generated-summary rows, eligible copy rows, and their LEFT JOIN relation; no metric aggregation or response conversion.
extraction.why: The joined generation/copy relation can be consumed by another aggregate without copying feature eligibility and linkage SQL.
invariants: payload validity and copy data type1/2 gate
LEFT JOIN on all three keys and original aliases
metadata filters and conversation/event/source conditions unchanged

extraction.boundary: Raw message, retrieval action and used-moment row SELECT relations with metadata/attribute eligibility; outer RPC retains distinct counters and grouping.
extraction.why: Consumers can use feature-qualified raw row relations and choose their own aggregation without prematurely deduplicating session IDs or changing current group grain.
invariants: nonempty session and original action/moment predicates
canonical conversation/row/session columns preserve raw row grain and source aliases
distinct session counting remains at requested grouping
message-derived group/user denominator and existing LEFT JOIN default values
metadata,args,external-table context and response conversion unchanged

fixed_refactor_regressions.title: GenAI combined metadata joins hid outer grouping columns
fixed_refactor_regressions.trigger: RetrieveKnowledgeAssistStats with both metadata inclusion and exclusion, agent/day grouping.
fixed_refactor_regressions.baseline: The exact frozen MetadataIncludeAndExclude RPC returned an empty response on original production.
fixed_refactor_regressions.failure: The prior raw-row wrapper SELECT table.* failed with ClickHouse code47, missing conversation_start_time and agent_user_id in the outer aggregate.
fixed_refactor_regressions.cause: Qualified wildcard columns under combined metadata joins did not expose the canonical names required by the new outer subquery.
fixed_refactor_regressions.fix: Only the GenAI raw-row helper projection changed to explicit table.field AS field columns: conversation identity/time/agent plus message ID, action ID/type/session or moment ID/type/session. Filters, joins, argument order, grouping and physical row multiplicity are unchanged.
fixed_refactor_regressions.root_review: Root independently checked the exact helper diff: predicates/args unchanged, IDs/type/session retained, no DISTINCT, physical duplicates preserved; supported outer group keys are agent_user_id and truncated_time.
